Stable first, changing last: the tools, then the system prompt, then the messages, with the new message at the end.
front: Put the parts of a request in the order the cache reads them.

back: A change at one level invalidates that level and every level after it: tools, then system, then messages.
On Sonnet 5.5, a cache hit costs $0.10 per million tokens. Base input costs $2 per million tokens.
front: What does a cache hit cost, against base input, on Sonnet 5.5?

back: Cache read tokens divided by all input tokens. The usage reports cache reads, cache writes and the uncached input as separate counts.
front: What is a cache hit rate?

back: The point up to which a request asks to be cached. The course's model uses one, at the end of the request.
A change at one level invalidates that level and every level after it, so a block that changes on every call misses from its own level on.
front: Which block breaks a cache when it changes on every call?

back: The default cache TTL is five minutes.
